community_text:
[Rating: 1/10] I really hate bluffing games. What's the point? Who cares? I just pick randomly and hope the game is over quickly.

[Rating: 1/10] I'm amazed that I found a game that I hate more than The Resistance. This required me to raise my rating for The Resistance to 1.1

[Rating: 1/10] Completely deterministic past a certain point.  Doesn't even count as a game IMO.

[Rating: 1/10] Worst game I've played in years. Took longer to explain than to play. 4 player game and yes we did understand the rules. Artwork is irrelevant since you don't see cards much. Might as well had letters like A for Assassin (seriously overbalanced role). Theme - non existant. Only upside is that it's mercifully short.

[Rating: 1/10] Oh boy i hate this game. This is not fun, ok it's a short game, but for some reason i always fail. A thing i don't have in Avelon / resistance / loveletter / spyfall / Sherffif of Nothingham / Bang / Skulls. Way better bluffing games wich go further then the simple question are you ... ? In coup thats only it. A chance of 50% of being killed, not less not more.

[Rating: 1/10] Versión P&P! Otro mojón de faroleo y roles ocultos. Con el Love Letter ya tuve bastante!

[Rating: 1/10] Is there even strategy for this game? You get randomly couped, which gives you no way to interact and you're half dead. Can I please get couped again so I can play a good game?

[Rating: 1/10] Nothing I am ever going to play again. Yuck! Was initially a 3 but on reflection there is nothing here but guessing, and not even fun guessing. Twice (in 4 tries, can't really call them games), I had duplicates of the 3 cards in the deck. Each time another player (3-player games) said he had THAT character. Of course I challenged.. and lost both times. Probability was about 4:1 on my side but I lost anyway; guessing is just guessing.  Gawd!! Forced to play 2 more times. What utter crap!

[Rating: 1/10] This "game" is awful and unbalanced; all games should be assembled, burned down and erased from history.  Note: bluffing is not my cup of tea

[Rating: 1/10] As a rule I don't like these social deduction games, but Coup has an edge for being very simple and fast.  The card counting is on the same level as Love Letter..  If I'm gonna get press-ganged into a social deduction game I'd prefer it to be this or Spyfall.
